summary.text: Matt Morgan is a Republican member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 29A, in St. Mary's County, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He has served in the House since 2015 and sits on the Health Committee.

paragraphs.text: Morgan was born in La Plata, Maryland, and graduated from Maurice J. McDonough High School in 1992.

He worked as a systems engineer and technician at AAA Networks and as a network analyst and information technology assistant manager at Fulbright and Jaworski, then spent 2001 to 2016 as lead technical specialist at the Prince Frederick campus of the College of Southern Maryland.
He has also been a realtor with O'Brien Realty since 2005.
Morgan was first elected to the House of Delegates in 2014 and has been a member since 2015.

He served on the Health and Government Operations Committee from 2015 to 2025 and was Assistant Minority Leader from 2019 to 2021; in 2026 he sits on the Health Committee and its Pharmaceuticals, Insurance, and Elder and Long-Term Care subcommittees.
He has served on the Maryland Medicaid Advisory Committee and the Tri-County Council for Southern Maryland since 2015.
